limits: A valid receipt says each party’s key signed its own part and the parts chain. It does not say any party told the truth.

The carried keys are the parties’ only if the verifier already holds those key_ids from somewhere else. A receipt cannot vouch for its own keys. When two roles are signed by one key, one holder signed both.
The acceptance names who accepted. The signature proves the acceptor’s key signed the receipt, not that the person named did.
money none means no money is held or paid by this receipt.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a receipt that still verifies.
The checks prove only what they test. A passed record says the pinned commands exited 0 on that tree, not that the work is good.
A test that cannot fail is not detected by this record.

The checker ran them as recorded only as far as the verifier trusts the checker’s key. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued the record, and content_hash that it was not edited since; the carried key is the checker’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a record that still verifies.
A delivery says what the doer’s Tick recorded handing in, not that the work is right. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued it, and content_hash that it was not edited since.
cents marked reported came from the agent’s platform and were not measured.
It does not prove the order exists or that this delivery answers it; that is checked where a receipt binds the two.
The carried key is the doer’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else. A delivery cannot vouch for its own key.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a delivery that still verifies.
A work order says what was asked, not that anything was done. The signature proves the holder of the carried key issued it, and content_hash that it was not edited since.
The carried key is the buyer’s only if the verifier already holds that key_id from somewhere else. A work order cannot vouch for its own key.
limits is not covered by the signature: someone who removes it leaves a work order that still verifies.
payment none means no money is held for this order.

WHAT HAPPENED (2026-10-28, run 01a1828d-2b1d-76c8-8d2a-5f4869cadcfd, auto tick on). Auto tick approved gates and access requests within seconds, yet the window kept being told they waited. tick_approve answered "GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED ... was already approved" and, in the same answer, "Waiting for the person: run 01a1828d-..., which this window started, has a acceptance gate on task 01a18290-64ff-70fe-bae3-d080d28d54b0 waiting for their decision. Tell them: ..."; tick_amendments_approve answered "AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL_ALREADY_DECIDED" followed by "... asking that it may change ... The task waits for their answer." The agent was told to put to the person what was already decided. The cause: WaitingNotices (packages/cli/src/talk-waiting.ts) reads what waits at most every 30 s and adds each item to the window's inbox (packages/cli/src/window-inbox.ts), where it stays pending until told or expired; nothing takes back an item whose gate or request has since been decided, by auto tick (talk-mcp.ts approveWaiting) or by anyone. Also the line says "has a acceptance gate" (talk-waiting.ts, about line 293).

This task starts after "A proposal that adds work waits on the person like any other" has landed: read talk-waiting.ts on the main you are cut from, with its `adds` items.

WHAT TO BUILD.
1. The inbox can take back pending items by what they are about (InboxAbout: run and task), for the kinds gate and access: `withdraw(about)` drops a pending item and leaves one already told alone. window-inbox.ts is 517 lines, exactly its entry in file-size-baseline.json: it may not grow; put the new code in packages/cli/src/inbox-withdraw.ts (or window-inbox-parts.ts, 
already its helper) and pay for any line added to window-inbox.ts in the same change. Do not edit file-size-baseline.json.
2. Items are withdrawn when their subject is decided: (a) each waiting read in WaitingNotices.add withdraws the pending gate and access items of the runs it read that are no longer in what it returned; (b) talk-mcp.ts withdraws a gate's or proposal's item when this window decides it, by auto tick's approveWaiting or by the agent's tick_approve, tick_reject, tick_amendments_approve or tick_amendments_reject, and when such a call is answered that it was already decided (GATE_ALREADY_DECIDED, AMENDMENT_PROPOSAL_ALREADY_DECIDED), before that answer is given the window's news. talk-mcp.ts is 1850 lines, exactly its baseline: it may not grow; move code out to inbox-withdraw.ts to pay for what you add.
3. The line names the gate with the right article: "an acceptance gate", "a plan gate", "a manual gate". Tests pin the words "the acceptance gate on task" and "Waiting for a person: the manual gate" (packages/cli/src/run-commands.test.ts:2920, 2955, 3023; agent-state-hook.test.ts:96, 148; first-run.e2e.test.ts:589 matches /gate on task (\S+) waiting/): keep "gate on task <id> waiting" and those sentences as they are.

Read talk-waiting-keeper.test.ts, talk-waiting-paused.test.ts and window-inbox.test.ts, and grep the whole tree's *.test.ts for "has a ", takeForAnswer and Inbox before you finish; every existing assertion keeps passing.
